Tenant Sub Cloud Resource Get Country Dc Exclusion Info
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/subclouds/isLastDcInCountry/:id

Retrieves the list of all the excluded data centers in a country

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the country

QUERY PARAMETERS
dcId
int32[]

Data center ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [

string
